title: Project One
summary: Designing an immersive digital racing experience.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Designing a seamless digital layer for a physical racing experience that enhances engagement without distracting from the event itself.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Focused on clarity, real-time feedback, and reducing cognitive load while maintaining excitement.

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Improved engagement, clearer race interaction, and a more immersive fan experience.

title: Project Two
summary: Improving onboarding and reducing drop-off rates.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Users were dropping off early in the onboarding flow due to unclear steps and unnecessary friction.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Mapped user journeys and simplified the onboarding flow into fewer, clearer steps.

sections.text: Simplifying complexity improved completion rates significantly.

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Increased onboarding completion and improved first-time user retention.
